plugins.description: Save web pages and YouTube videos, or just the parts that matter, as summarized, tagged clips: a Markdown file in ChatGPT or an HTML file in Claude by default, or saved to Google Drive, Notion, a Cowork project, your Claude Code project, or a private claude.ai artifact, from the Chrome side panel, the Claude Code desktop browser, or ChatGPT's connected Chrome tabs and Work browser. Local-first preferences set destinations and formats, with optional Google Drive sync.
